eD82tyBrM4c.descricao:
Some melodies don't age. They wait for the right moment to be played again! 
Find this nostalgic vibe here: https://spti.fi/STeasylady

With its unforgettable vocals, irresistible melody, and unmistakable Italian charm, Spagna – Easy Lady became one of the defining dance records of the 1980s. Decades later, it still captures the same excitement, bringing generations of listeners back to packed dancefloors, summer nights, and memories that never fade.

Summer Hitz Throwback '26 is a celebration of those timeless moments. From iconic Eurodance and Italo Disco to unforgettable club anthems, this series brings together the songs that continue to soundtrack summers around the world—yesterday, today, and for years to come.

Whether you've loved Easy Lady for decades or you're discovering it for the very first time, welcome to a collection where great music never grows old.

🎧 Explore the complete Summer Hitz Throwback '26 playlist: https://spti.fi/SHT262

LETRA - Plática de hormigas pts. 1 & 2 ft. José Madero

Pt. 1 – Canción de cuna al insomnio 

Mi cuerpo dijo “¡basta!”, 
sin embargo, mi cerebro encuentra modos 
de obtener aquello que le plazca.
Y, en retrospectiva, en mi casa así somos todos. 
La mitad de mi herencia fue dada en vida:
 “En esta familia no hay genios. Trabajen más” 
Lo restante, supongo, en un banco metida. 
Y por una, de la otra no ha habido necesidad. 
Oh, mira, lo que podríamos comprar 
si la culpa fuera una moneda.
Otra noche más sin descansar,
separando el trigo de la paja, los “debí” de los “hubieras”.  
Cambio incertidumbre por Magnesio, 
sólo estoy anticipándomele al Rivotril. 
Antes era apasionado, hoy sólo necio. 
Cámbiame ser ambicioso por servil.
De algo va a servir, 
—¡de algo tiene que servir!—, 
el trabajo duro y el empeño.
Explícame por qué no puedo dormir 
si supuestamente estoy viviendo el sueño. 
Y me encuentro inerte y retraído, 
ensimismado y poco comunicativo;
por qué prefiero estar enfocado, obsesionado, y solo,  
que riendo en un bar con mis amigos

Y aunque todo esté mal. 
A nadie va a importar. 
Mañana toca empezar otra vez. 

De nuevo desperté a las 3 am. 
Un desperdicio si no sabes a qué temes.  
A esta hora lo único que rescato, por mi alma, 
es voltear y verle dormir con tanta calma. 
Hoy empezamos temprano, la carrera sin meta, 
Doy gracias por el lujo: traer tenis cómodos. 
Quisiera me ahorre preguntas la careta 
donde traigo la sonrisa del Sísifo de Camus. 
Si entre hormigas nos asinceramos 
tengo claro que si importo
es sólo por lo que hago.
Condiciono la valía de mi vida, a mis logros. 
Entre banderas rojas, tomo del cuerno a los toros. 
Yo soy el culpable, no busco pretexto. 
¿Existe un supuesto Yo fuera de esto?
Porque he dado tanto, que ya corto en cicatrices.
Mentiría si no admitiera: “esto es todo lo que quise”. 
Y ya que lo hice, pon otra paloma en la casilla,
otra línea burda cruzando el pendiente. 
La victoria, ¡qué bebida tan insípida! 
bar tender, algo más fuerte, distraiga mi mente 
de otra campaña auto-destructiva, otra oración sin fe.
¿Qué sigue?
Hice tal amistad con el café 
que pareciera que Freddy Krueger me persigue. 

Y aunque todo esté mal, 
a nadie va a importar: 
mañana toca empezar otra vez. 

Y la salud mental 
está bien pa’ los demás. 
Tratarme horrible me funciona bien. 

Y aunque todo esté mal, 
a nadie va a importar: 
mañana toca empezar otra vez.

HA LEYLİM / _OH MY NOCTURNAL ONE_

Baş koydum senle aşkın yastığına / _I placed my head on the pillow of love with you_ 
Aşkolsun gelme görmezden / _I plead with you, don’t overlook me_
Yangın var bende söndürüver bari / _There’s a fire burning in me, won’t you put it out_
Bir rüzgar esti körfezden / _A wind just blew in from the bay_

Alsam versem de düşse bu süngü / _Let me take and let me give, so I can lower my guard_
O ağzında bir güneşlensem / _If only I could sunbathe in that mouth of yours_ 
Çektim çoktan kapılarına sürgüyü / _It’s been a long time since I have bolted your doors_
Ya teslim ol ya güreş benlen / _Either surrender or wrestle with me_

Kaptırdım seline, kandım meçhulüne / _I’m caught up in your flood, fooled by your unknown quality_
Sayende ağaç oldum burda / _Thanks to you I’m kicking my heels here_
Sokağında caddende / _On your side street, on your main street_
Sabrımın da sonu var biline / _May it be known there’s an end to my patience_
Kızgın demir hep avucumda / _The searing iron is always in my palm_
Darlandı müneccimler / _All the fortune-tellers are in distress_
Gel kurtar oku değdir kalbime / _Come rescue the arrow make it strike my heart_ 
Çabuk, haydi çabuk / _Rush, come on and rush_

Ha leylim bi’ ses ver be güzelim / _Oh my nocturnal one, call out to me, my beautiful one_ 
Bu gece bana gel şeker ezelim / _Come to me tonight, let’s crush our sweet crush_
Yaradan duysun da, muradımı versin de / _May God hear me, and grant me my wish_ 
Yaz maz gelsin gezinelim / _Let summer come so we can wander together_

Garibim, keşkem ve helalim / _My peculiar one, my wish, my rightful one_
Dola sen boynuma vebalin’ / _Embrace me, may its sin be on me_
Nişanımız olsun da, tüm kasaba bilsin de / _Let’s get engaged, and let the whole town know_
Sağ elinde dursun sol elim, sol elim / _Let me place my left hand, my left hand, in your right hand_
(Muhabbet bağında yüzelim) / _(Let’s wade in the orchard of affection)_

Your Love Is My Grave.

A heartbeat buried beneath the earth.
A love that refuses to rest.

**"YOUR LOVE IS MY GRAVE"** is a dark and emotional industrial metal duet about eternal love, heartbreaking loss, obsession, and the devastating beauty of holding on to someone who exists only in memories. Blending crushing industrial guitar riffs, haunting piano melodies, cinematic orchestration, and powerful male and female vocals, the song creates an intense dialogue between two souls separated by life, yet forever bound by love.

One voice calls from the darkness.

The other answers from beyond.

Together, they tell a story where love becomes both salvation and curse. Every whispered word carries sorrow. Every chorus echoes through forgotten graves. Every note reminds us that some hearts continue beating long after hope has faded.

Love can conquer time.

But it cannot always conquer fate.

When the world grows silent...

Their voices remain.

AZxqKcNmqZ0.descricao:
DUWOLU – Official Music Video by Nyancho

“Duwolu”, a Mandinka word meaning (Vultures) is the latest powerful social commentary from Gambian artist Nyancho.
Following the message of Wulolu, Duwolu continues Nyancho’s call for unity, peace, justice, accountability, and a better future for The Gambia. The song gives a voice to the frustrations and struggles experienced by ordinary Gambians, particularly young people and those whose voices are often unheard.
The message of Duwolu is not intended as an accusation against the Government or any individual. Rather, it is an appeal and a reminder that many ordinary citizens are struggling and deserve better opportunities, security, justice, and dignity.
Over the years, Gambians have witnessed public discussions and allegations surrounding corruption, misuse of public resources, unexplained wealth, and the disappearance or mismanagement of public funds. We have also seen questions raised about how some individuals who lived modestly for many years later acquired significant wealth, expensive vehicles, and large properties after entering positions of influence.

There have also been concerns about public officials who have spoken against corruption or challenged wrongdoing and subsequently lost their positions. Whether through political disagreements, institutional decisions, or other circumstances, these situations have raised important questions about accountability and transparency.

At the same time, our communities continue to face serious challenges. Innocent people have lost their lives to crime, while many families continue to seek answers and justice. Tribal and divisive rhetoric has also become a concern, with words that can create tension and threaten the unity that Gambians have worked hard to preserve.

And perhaps most importantly, our young people are struggling.
Youth unemployment remains a major challenge. Many young Gambians see irregular migration as their only path toward a better life, risking their lives on dangerous journeys instead of finding opportunities at home. Every young person who leaves represents not only a personal loss, but potentially the loss of a future leader, entrepreneur, artist, professional, or community builder.
Duwolu is therefore a reflection of what many Gambians are feeling and experiencing.
It is a call for those in positions of power to listen to the people.
A call for accountability.
A call for justice.
A call for unity.
A call for peace.
And above all, a call to build a Gambia where every citizen has a fair opportunity to live with dignity and hope.
This song is not about attacking anyone.
It is about asking difficult questions.
It is about speaking for those who may not have a platform.
It is about reminding ourselves that The Gambia belongs to all of us.

@rachelnovaesoficial apresenta Eu e Minha Casa, composição autoral que abre os lançamentos do álbum que celebra seus 25 anos de ministério. A faixa ganhou um significado especial ao ser interpretada por Rachel ao lado da família: ela divide os vocais com a filha, Bia, enquanto o marido, Marcelo, e o filho, Samuel, a acompanham nos violões.

O medley compõe a primeira parte do projeto, intitulada Promessa, ao lado de Ele Vem Pra Te Salvar e Confiar / Tu és Fiel, Senhor. “Não tinha jeito melhor de inaugurar isso do que cantando com eles, declarando aquilo que a gente tem perseguido, tentado escolher todos os dias: Eu e minha casa serviremos ao Senhor, e que essa verdade também possa ser vivida por você”, compartilha a cantora gospel, que também é conhecida por louvores como Mil Motivos, com Fernandinho, Alegria / Sou Feliz, Obrigado Jesus Pelo Seu Sangue, Minh’alma Engrandece ao Senhor / Adorado, com Thamires Garcia, e O Amor de Deus / Logo Eu.

O trabalho tem ainda as participações de grandes nomes do meio, como Pr. Adhemar de Campos, Paulo César Baruk, Júlio Filho, além dos grupos Novo Canto e FHOP Music. Ao todo, o projeto, gravado ao vivo na IPALPHA, conta com 15 faixas, entre inéditas e releituras. O repertório será dividido em cinco blocos, cada um inspirado em uma temática bíblica. https://www.instagram.com/davidbisbal/ sorprendió al público de https://www.instagram.com/operaciontriunfousa/ al interpretar “El Amar Y El Querer”, uno de los grandes éxitos de José José, en la última gala del programa.

Su presencia en el escenario fue recibido con una gran ovación por parte de la audiencia, quienes además de aplaudir su gran voz, vivieron el regreso de David al escenario de Operación Triunfo después de 25 años. 

Esta presentación nos acerca más a ‘ETERNOS’, el próximo álbum del español, el cual saldrá el 2 de octubre. Se trata de un homenaje a las canciones más emblemáticas de la música en español.

Campedrinos junto a Euge Quevedo haciendo folklore.

XhGa81cvico.descricao:
“Mother Told Me” is one of the 15 songs from Wolfskald’s sea shanty album, Echoes from the Deep.

This song is the next chapter in an ongoing cinematic story of loss, courage, loyalty, and the strength to keep moving forward.

After surviving the darkness of the sea, a warrior returns to the people she once left behind. Together, they rebuild more than a ship—they rebuild hope, purpose, and the courage to begin again. But their journey is far from over.

Inspired by the spirit of sea shanties and cinematic maritime folk music, “Mother Told Me” carries the voices, storms, memories, and determination of those who refuse to surrender to the sea.

This music video continues the story from the previous chapter, and the story will continue in future videos. Subscribe to the channel, turn on notifications, and follow Wolfskald so you don’t miss the next part.

Thank you for watching and supporting this journey.
Like, comment, share, and add the song to your playlists.

The journey continues…

ORE COMIGO | Uma Oração Para Quem Está Cansado |  Echo of Grace (Oficial)
Inscreva-se no canal 👉 @EchoofGrace

Talvez hoje você não tenha palavras para orar.

Talvez esteja cansado, preocupado com o amanhã, tentando permanecer forte enquanto ninguém percebe o que está acontecendo dentro de você.

Então… ore comigo.

“Ore Comigo” nasceu como uma oração por quem está enfrentando dias difíceis. Por quem perdeu alguma coisa. Por quem está sozinho. Por quem precisa perdoar. Por quem está lutando contra tentações. Por quem está tentando recomeçar.

E também por aquele que simplesmente precisa dizer:

“Jesus, eu não quero desistir.”

Há momentos nesta canção em que não queremos cantar bonito. Queremos apenas abrir o coração diante de Deus.

Mesmo doendo… eu confio.

Mesmo chorando… eu confio.

Que enquanto você ouvir esta oração, sua casa seja alcançada, sua fé seja fortalecida e seu coração encontre novamente esperança em Jesus.

🎧 Ouça até o final como uma oração.

🙏 Se puder, feche os olhos por alguns minutos e ore conosco.

💡 Se esta canção falou com você, deixe seu like 👍, inscreva-se e compartilhe para que mais pessoas sejam alcançadas.* 🙏✨

qedUrwGIkdo.descricao:
ay Amores Que Nunca Mueren… Solo Aprendemos A Vivir Con Su Recuerdo ❤️

Hay amores que no terminan con un adiós...
solo cambian de lugar y comienzan a vivir en nuestros recuerdos.

Este bolero romántico habla de ese amor que pasó hace mucho tiempo, pero que nunca desapareció por completo. Un amor que ya no duele como antes, pero que todavía vive en una canción, una fotografía, una mirada o un recuerdo.

Porque olvidar no siempre significa dejar de amar.

A veces simplemente aprendemos a seguir adelante llevando en el corazón aquello que alguna vez nos hizo felices.

🎵 “Hay Amores Que Nunca Mueren” es un bolero romántico de inspiración vintage, con una atmósfera cálida y nostálgica que recuerda a los grandes boleros latinoamericanos de los años 60.

❤️ Para quienes alguna vez amaron de verdad.
💔 Para quienes tuvieron que aprender a vivir con un recuerdo.
🌹 Para quienes todavía guardan una historia de amor en el corazón.

Si esta canción te hizo recordar a alguien especial, déjanos saber en los comentarios:

¿Hay algún amor que todavía vive en tus recuerdos?

Suscríbete a BOLEROS RECUERDO para descubrir más boleros románticos, canciones de amor, nostalgia y melodías que nunca mueren.

📌This is the moment when someone is gone, yet their presence still lingers in every corner of the room.
It is a song about choosing dignity over longing, accepting the tears without surrendering to them, and reclaiming the right to decide what stays, what is released, and where life goes next. 
Healing does not mean you never bend. It means that, even through the pain, you keep walking until your life belongs to you again.


Evening leaning on the walls
Shadows stretching down the halls
Your keys still waited by the door
For hands that won’t come back once more..

One empty hook beside the frame
The smallest things still keep your name
Some people fit beneath your skin
That doesn't mean you let them in
Don’t mistake my calm for torn,
I know exactly what went wrong

It is, like a promise,  past its date
What to lose,  and what to save 
And I stand here inside this place
Where the silence, wears your face

I won’t beg for what is gone
I don’t feed what will not grow
No more waiting for a sign
I decide this life is mine
Yes, I decide this life is mine. 
I may bend, but I’ll be fine. 

Your number lives inside my phone
Like a road that leads back home
I nearly sent you something small
But it wouldn’t change, a thing at all

I watch the evening change the room
Making space where you once moved
And the silence starts to sound
Like my voice comes back around
Some people settle in your bones
Then leave you colder than alone. 

It is, like a promise,  past its date
What to lose,  and what to save. 
And I stand here inside this place
Where the silence, wears your face

I won’t beg for what is gone
I don’t feed what will not grow
No more waiting for a sign
I decide this life is mine
Yes I decide this life is mine
I may bend, but I’ll be fine

Some goodbyes show you who you are
When you stop hiding every scar
Even if I melt into tears
I’ll keep walking through my fears.

zcVKHIzusiQ.descricao:
“Музико” — це насамперед пісня про людські почуття. Про те, що за кожною професією, формою, викликом чи відповідальністю завжди стоїть людина — зі своїми страхами, любов’ю, втомою, мріями й бажанням просто повернутися додому.

Під час війни ми всі вчимося жити між тривогами й надією, між важкими новинами та простими моментами, які раптом стають найціннішими. Ми продовжуємо працювати, любити, підтримувати одне одного, робити свою справу — попри все, що відбувається навколо.

Сьогодні мільйони українців розкидані по всьому світу. Хтось будує нове життя далеко від дому, хтось щодня мріє повернутися, хтось зустрічає світанки в іншій країні, але засинає з Україною в серці. Відстань може розділяти нас географічно, але вона не здатна забрати відчуття дому. Бо дім — це не лише місце. Це люди, до яких хочеться повертатися, мова, яку хочеться чути, спогади, які завжди живуть із тобою.

Мені хотілося, щоб “Музико” була саме про це — про нас справжніх. Про тих, хто тримається, продовжує жити, знаходить сили усміхатися, кохати й берегти своє, навіть коли поруч війна. І водночас — про тих, хто сьогодні далеко, але душею залишається тут. Де б не опинився українець, частинка його серця завжди знає дорогу додому.

Саме тому в кліпі ми показали людей різних професій, які щодня тримають чиєсь життя, місто, країну. Але за всіма їхніми рішеннями, відповідальністю й напругою є просте людське бажання — повернутися до своїх. До обіймів, до рідного голосу, до звичайного вечора поруч із найважливішими людьми.

“Музико” — про тих, хто тримає цей світ, і про тих, заради кого вони це роблять. І якщо після перегляду кліпу вам захочеться зателефонувати своїм, обійняти близьких або просто ввімкнути пісню ще раз — значить, ми зробили все правильно».

With a career spanning more than 15 years, Dosem first joined the Anjunadeep family in 2018 with the two-track single ‘Not A Coincidence / Why Give Up Before We Try’. Renowned for club records that soundtrack late-night sessions and early-morning moments alike, Dosem has released music on labels including Toolroom, Armada, Purified and his own imprint Houstrike, alongside delivering remixes for Hot Since 82, Above & Beyond and Eli & Fur. He is also widely recognised for his 2021 collaboration with Tinlicker, ‘Hypnotised’, which has amassed over 10 million streams.

The EP features the previously released singles 'Levitize' and 'Morning Runner', which have collectively earned support from Eelke Kleijn, Kölsch, Hernan Cattaneo, John Digweed and Anna Lunoe. These sit alongside three brand-new tracks including 'I Got You', showcasing Dosem's signature progressive house sound, driven by evolving synths, hypnotic melodies and a driving bassline.

"Y volveré" (1970) de Los Ángeles Negros es una obra maestra de la música latinoamericana que revolucionó la balada romántica al fusionar la instrumentación del rock británico con el sentimiento del bolero, un género bautizado como "bolero-beat". D3VM4hfgerM.titulo: Die Toten Hosen // Junkies und Scientologen [feat. Thees Uhlmann] (Offizielles Musikvideo)
D3VM4hfgerM.descricao:
Die nächste Runde aus unserer Bonusplatte „Alles muss raus!“ haben wir mit unserem engen Freund und hochgeschätzten Kollegen Thees Uhlmann gedreht. „Junkies und Scientologen“ ist eines unserer Lieblingslieder von ihm und ganz nebenbei ist dabei das längste Toten Hosen-Video entstanden, das es je gegeben hat!
Als wir Thees vor vielen Jahren kennenlernten, war es schnell Liebe auf den ersten Blick. Seitdem war er immer wieder mit uns als musikalischer Gast unterwegs, wir haben unzählige Abende miteinander verbracht, viel geredet, gelacht und gefeiert.
Thees hat ein riesengroßes Herz und ist ein großartiger Geschichtenerzähler, ein im allerbesten Sinne Verrückter und gleichzeitig ein fanatischer, beseelter Musiker, Sänger und Texter, der für seine Musik brennt und hinreißende Konzerte gibt. Kurz gesagt: Wir mögen diesen Mann wirklich sehr.
Und so freuen wir uns, dass Thees in den nächsten Tagen bei einigen Terminen wieder mit uns unterwegs sein und die Bühne mit uns teilen wird.

Das dazugehörige Album „Trink aus, wir müssen gehen!“ + Bonusalbum „Alles muss raus!“ ist am 29.05.2026 erschienen und kann hier » https://dietotenhosen.lnk.to/trinkaus als Dreifach-Vinylalbum und Doppel-CD bestellt werden.

PNbHqUM4gMI.descricao:
"Murió la Flor" es una de las obras cumbre de la música romántica latinoamericana, lanzada originalmente en 1969 por la banda chilena Los Ángeles Negros e incluida en su histórico álbum de 1970, Y Volveré. Coescrita por el vocalista Germaín de la Fuente y el bajista Nano Concha, la composición nació inspirada en un dicho popular que repetía la madre de Germaín: "Muere la flor y al secarse deja en su cáliz su esencia". Esta melodía consolidó el género de la "balada rock" o "balada rítmica", mezclando el desgarro de la canción cebolla con arreglos propios del rock psicodélico de la época.

Hailing from Louisville, Illinois, multi-platinum singer-songwriter Bailey Zimmerman is one of country music’s brightest stars, known for his chart topping hits and authentic gritty sound. After first gaining traction by posting original songs to social media in 2020, Zimmerman rocketed into the spotlight with the viral success of “Fall in Love,” which made him the fastest debut country artist to reach No. 1 on Billboard’s Country Airplay chart in over a decade.
 
In 2023, Zimmerman released his debut album Religiously. The Album. which arrived as not only the biggest streaming debut for a country album in history, but also the biggest all-genre streaming debut since 2021. The “comfortably bruising and appealingly bruised” (The New York Times) album also features his fourth consecutive No. 1 single “Where It Ends,” his 4x-Platinum, No. 1 debut single, “Fall In Love,” and its 5x-Platinum follow-up, the six-week No. 1 mega-hit “Rock And A Hard Place.” The album debuted at #3 on the Top Country Albums chart and #7 on the Billboard 200, instantly positioning him as one of the genre’s most impactful new voices.
 
In 2024, Zimmerman continued to dominate the charts with singles "Holy Smokes,” “Holding On” and “New To Country” all of which made a splash. August of 2025 saw the release of Zimmerman’s Sophomore album Different Night Same Rodeo which features superstar collaboration “Backup Plan” featuring Luke Combs as well as Top 10 and platinum single “Holy Smokes,” in addition to “New To Country,” “Hell or High Water,” “Holding On,” “Comin’ In Cold,” and more. 
 
Zimmerman has earned multiple award nominations, including nods from the Billboard Music Awards, ACM Awards, People’s Choice Country Awards, and CMT Music Awards—cementing his status as one of country music’s fastest-rising stars. He has ignited television audiences across the country with show-stopping performances on Good Morning America, TODAY, The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon, Jimmy Kimmel Live!, the 58th Academy of Country Music Awards, and the 2024 CMT Music Awards and more. Beyond the stage, Zimmerman has drawn widespread acclaim from top-tier media outlets including Forbes, Rolling Stone, Variety, Los Angeles Times, Billboard, American Songwriter, and more. For more about Bailey Zimmerman, please visit baileyzimmermanmusic.com.

#GregGonzalez #KAROLG #DespuesDeTi
🎵KAROL G, Greg Gonzalez - Después de ti 

La canción “Después de ti” de KAROL G junto a Greg Gonzalez es una canción íntima y melancólica sobre el vacío que deja una persona después de una ruptura. A través de una atmósfera suave y nostálgica, ambos artistas exploran la dificultad de imaginar cómo continuar cuando alguien importante ya no está.
La canción refleja el momento posterior a una relación importante, cuando los recuerdos siguen presentes y la persona intenta adaptarse a una vida diferente. No se trata solamente de extrañar a alguien, sino de sentir que una parte de la rutina, los sueños y la propia identidad estaba ligada a esa relación.
La participación de Greg Gonzalez refuerza esta sensación de intimidad y nostalgia, creando una especie de diálogo entre dos voces que parecen compartir el recuerdo de un amor que ya no existe.

cR4EQ_dI1BM.titulo: Miley Cyrus & Dolly Parton Perform “Wrecking Ball” / “I Will Always Love You” | Full Performance
cR4EQ_dI1BM.descricao:
Remembering Dolly Parton, the Queen of Country Music, through one of her most unforgettable performances with goddaughter Miley Cyrus. 🤍

During Miley’s New Year’s Eve Party, Miley and Dolly shared the stage for several songs throughout the night, including “Jolene,” “I Love Rock ’n’ Roll” and “Walkin’ After Midnight.”

One of the most emotional moments came when they performed Miley’s “Wrecking Ball” before transitioning into Dolly’s “I Will Always Love You.”

Written and originally recorded by Dolly in the 1970s, “I Will Always Love You” became one of the defining songs of her career and later reached another generation through Whitney Houston’s iconic recording.

Hearing Miley sing the song alongside the woman who wrote it made the performance feel especially powerful, bringing together two generations of music history and the close personal bond they shared.

Following Dolly Parton’s passing at age 80, moments like this carry an entirely new weight.

Rest in peace, Dolly. Your songs, songwriting and influence will live forever. 🤍

What’s your favorite Miley Cyrus and Dolly Parton performance?

qC5KhLF58E4.descricao:
Roberto Carlos - El gato que está triste y azul

"Un gato en la oscuridad" (popularmente conocida como "El gato que está triste y azul") 🐱💙 es un clásico inolvidable de Roberto Carlos 🎤 que aborda la melancolía, el desamor y la soledad tras la pérdida de un gran amor 💔.

La letra utiliza la figura del gato 🐈‍⬛ como una metáfora del protagonista: un ser solitario 🚶‍♂️ que vaga por la noche 🌌, sumido en la tristeza y sintiendo un vacío enorme tras la partida de esa persona especial 🥀. El color azul 🔵 no solo evoca la calma y la noche, sino que simboliza la depresión y la nostalgia pura (un concepto similar al término en inglés "feeling blue" 🌧️). La canción contrasta los recuerdos cálidos e íntimos del pasado ✨ con la realidad fría y oscura del presente 🌑, reflejando lo difícil que es aceptar el fin de una historia y reencontrarse a uno mismo en medio de la penumbra.

De 18-jarige Samuel Welten is geen onbekende in het Nederlandse live-circuit: hij was in 2024 de meest geboekte jonge zanger en was vaker weg voor optredens dan dat hij aan de bar zat in zijn Utrechtse stamkroeg. De afgelopen maanden bracht hij veel tijd door in de studio en schreef hij zijn debuut single ‘Echte liefde is te koop’. Met deze single steekt Samuel volksmuziek in een nieuw jasje. Fans van de zanger noemen de single nu al de zomerhit!

Samuel Welten (5 juli 2006) is een echte entertainer in hart en nieren. Met zijn grote glimlach, vlotte babbel en passie voor muziek verovert hij overal harten. Hij noemt zichzelf een pop-volksartiest en brengt met zijn optredens altijd een vrolijke sfeer. Al op 12-jarige leeftijd blies hij iedereen omver tijdens zijn deelname aan The Voice Kids. Samuel staat wekelijks op het podium, waar hij met zijn aanstekelijke energie en unieke stem het publiek weet te entertainen.

Com mais de 3,5 bilhões de views em suas músicas, Julliany Souza é atualmente considerada o maior nome da música gospel. Intérprete de grandes canções do segmento, como os sucessos “A Casa é Sua”, (a música cristã mais tocada do Spotify BR), “Lindo Momento” (música gospel do ano de 2024), "Quem É Esse?” (destaque de 2025 que atingiu a posição 41º na Billboard Hot 100 Brasil), “Eu e Minha Casa”, e tantas outras, já colaborou com nomes como Aline Barros, Bruna Karla, Isaías Saad e Eyshila.

A CRISTO SEJA A GLÓRIA marca o encontro inédito entre Julliany Souza e @GabrielaRochaOficial, duas das vozes mais influentes da música cristã brasileira. Dando continuidade ao álbum JESUS, após o sucesso de "AH, JESUS", a faixa apresenta a canção mais congregacional do projeto, exaltando a supremacia de Cristo e convidando a Igreja a declarar que toda honra e toda glória pertencem somente a Ele. tRQODBACpsA.descricao:
Zamba carpera sobre un amor que se fue, pero dejó sus raíces para siempre. “Flor Amarilla” atraviesa el adiós, la ausencia y ese deseo de volver a encontrarse, aun cuando el silencio parece confirmarlo todo.

Entre recuerdos, lunas crecientes y puertas que quedan entreabiertas, la canción habla de salir a la orilla después del naufragio y reconocer que, incluso en el dolor, haber querido también nos transforma.

Campedrinos junto a Euge Quevedo haciendo folklore.

De ziua Andrei, acest moment a fost unul complet spontan și privat, trăit alături de cei dragi. Câteva filmări scurte au ajuns însă online, iar reacția voastră a fost instantanee.

Ați început să ne scrieți foarte mulți și să cereți momentul integral. Dintr-o mână de filmări apărute pe TikTok, s-a transformat într-o adevărată cerere din partea voastră de a vedea momentul așa cum s-a întâmplat, de la început până la sfârșit.

Andra a văzut mesajele voastre și a ținut neapărat să vă facă această bucurie. Ne-a convins pe noi, echipa ei, să publicăm momentul integral, pentru ca voi să-l puteți vedea, în final, în varianta completă.

Așa ajunge astăzi pe YouTube un moment care nu a fost niciodată gândit pentru cameră sau pentru un public larg, ci pur și simplu pentru bucuria unei seri speciale, între prieteni. Vă mulțumim pentru toată dragostea și vă invităm să vă bucurați alături de noi!

sxUe40nPmKU.titulo: Wolfskald - Thunder in My Bones ( Official Music Video ) | Part IV | Sea Shanty #sea #music #epic
sxUe40nPmKU.descricao:
“Thunder in My Bones” — the journey continues.

What began with Torak Ven, continued through My Mother Told Me, and was thrown into chaos by the storm and the Kraken in Nordavind, now reaches a new chapter.
After surviving the sea and losing their ship, our warriors finally reach the island. For one night, the battles are left behind.
Inside a crowded medieval tavern, old friends reunite, cups are raised, stories are told, and the whole room comes alive with music. What starts as a simple welcome quickly turns into a wild night of sea shanties, dancing, laughter and friendship.
Thunder in My Bones is a lighter and more playful chapter of the story — but the adventure never truly stops.
As the celebration finally fades and the tavern falls silent, dawn brings something unexpected.
The island’s chief leads our warrior to a cold, mist-covered hill overlooking the coast. Below them waits a powerful Viking fleet, dozens of warriors and a vast shoreline stronghold.
Then the chief looks at her and makes one simple gesture:

It’s yours.

A new journey is about to begin.

⚔️ The story so far:
Torak Ven → My Mother Told Me → Nordavind → Thunder in My Bones

🎵 Part of the Echoes from the Deep universe.

If you enjoyed the song and the story, like the video, leave a comment, subscribe and share it with someone you’d take to sea with you.

The next chapter is coming.

Señor...
He buscado tantas cosas pensando que podían llenarme.

Sin Ti... no soy nada.

[Verso 1]

"Permanece en Mí, hija mía. Porque separado de Mí no hay fruto ni amor."

Como la rama necesita la vid para recibir vida y permanecer...
mi alma necesita de Ti.
Sin tu presencia... no sé quién soy.

Sin Ti no soy nada, Señor.
Sin tu amor no puedo vivir.
Todo lo que soy, todo lo que tengo, todo viene de Ti.
Sin Ti no soy nada, Señor.
Eres mi fuerza y mi razón.
Si el mundo entero desapareciera, si te tengo a Ti... tengo mi Salvador.

[Verso 2]
Cuando mis fuerzas llegan al límite, Tú eres quien me vuelve a levantar.

Porque ¿qué puede darme este mundo que sea más grande que tu amor?

[Pre-Coro]
¿A quién tengo en los cielos si no es a Ti?

Sin Ti no soy nada, Señor.
Eres mi fuerza y mi razón.
Si el mundo entero desapareciera, si te tengo a Ti... tengo mi Salvador.

Más de Ti... menos de mí.

Si tengo salud... sin Ti estoy vacío.

Ya no vivo yo. Cristo vive en mí.

Sin Él nada existe. Sin Él no puedo ser.

Mit "1993" veröffentlichen die "KrawallBrüder" nicht nur den Titeltrack, sondern auch die zweite Single Ihres kommenden Albums, welches am 11.09.2026 erscheint.

Bei dem Song handelt es sich um eine saubere Punkrocknummer, die gute Laune aufkommen lässt und dennoch ein wenig an Härte kann.
Das Mainriff geht direkt in's Ohr und bleibt hängen, genau wie der Refrain und so muss das auch sein. Textlich geht es um die Brüder im Laufe der Zeit im Positiven aber auch selbst reflektierenden Sinne.
Am Ende erwartet Euch einfach eine neue Hymne aus der KB Schmiede, wie Ihr sie liebt!

"...wir waren die besten Jungs der Stadt - hat Deine Mutter übrigens auch gesagt!"

Im Video sind neben den Brüdern übrigens alte Mitglieder der Band zu sehen, die KB nach wie vor nahe stehen und das gibt dem ganzen einen ganz persönlichen Touch. 
Danke an alle die dabei waren, namentlich:
Andy - Drums 1993-1996

xRKbX0Q0cGA.titulo: DAVID BISBAL | QUIJOTE | El sexto ETERNO: Don Julio Iglesias
xRKbX0Q0cGA.descricao:
El sexto ETERNO no podía faltar: Don Julio Iglesias. ❤️

Y llega con “Quijote”, una de esas canciones que escuchas después de tantos años y comprendes perfectamente por qué siguen formando parte de nuestra memoria.

Pero hay algo que quiero contaros de ETERNOS.

Este disco nació para rendir homenaje a las grandes voces y a las grandes canciones de una época maravillosa de nuestra música, pero también a quienes estuvieron detrás de ellas: los compositores, productores, arreglistas y músicos que ayudaron a convertirlas en clásicos.

Y “Quijote” es un ejemplo perfecto.

La canción fue escrita por Julio Iglesias, Manuel de la Calva y Ramón Arcusa, nuestro querido Dúo Dinámico, junto a Gianni Belfiore. Y Ramón Arcusa fue además productor de aquella grabación original, con arreglos junto a Rafael Ferro.

¡Qué generación, MADRE MIA!

Me hace muchísima ilusión poder llevar ahora “Quijote” a mi terreno, estudiarla, interpretarla con mi voz y, sobre todo, descubrirla con vosotros primero sobre el escenario.

Ya llevamos seis ETERNOS y cada vez queda menos para el 2 de octubre.

Pero todavía quedan algunos Eternos y Eternas por descubrir… y muchos los vais a conocer, como estamos haciendo hasta ahora, en vivo y en directo antes incluso de escuchar el disco.

Espero que disfrutéis de “Quijote”.

Experience George Michael: The Faith Tour in cinemas internationally from November 4. US & Canada December 11

Tickets on sale soon – stay tuned for updates. Pre-order album from September 2

George Michael was one of the most influential stars of his generation; his voice and songwriting defined an era. Assembled from rediscovered, previously unseen and unheard 35mm footage of his 1988 performance at the Palais Omnisports de Paris-Bercy, this new concert film captures George at the height of his creative power during the record-breaking Faith Tour. Expertly restored and remastered, the film transforms a defining cultural moment into a spectacular cinema experience. An original short film by Mary McCartney opens the feature, using newly discovered audio and imagery from 1986–1988 – the Faith era – creating a rare and intimate ‘time capsule’, offering a vivid insight into George’s mindset at this pivotal moment in his life.

Featuring: George Michael
Director: David Austin, Andy Morahan

9ap4QXClL3A.descricao:
Friends! It’s finally here, Scandinavian Eyes, one of our own favorite tracks from the upcoming album Come This Madness! ⚡️

We thought it was about time to deliver a performance video, created by none other than our dear friend Patric Ullaeus, who also brought you the videos for One on One and The Cult Of Ignorance.

Check it out and let us know what you think! 
#Europe #europetheband #comethismadness

Stream the single and pre-order the new album Come This Madness here: https://lnk.to/EuropeComeThisMadnessAlbum

Built around a driving riff, an unmistakable chorus, soaring vocal lines and arrangements, ‘Scandinavian Eyes’ is the kind of song that feels like a symphony built for the stage. There is an expansive quality to the track, with Europe combining the power and immediacy of rock with the depth of orchestral music. 

“This driving riff, orchestral magic, vocal and guitar melodies make this one of my favourite Europe songs in a long time! says Europe’s founding member and frontman Joey Tempest. “A lyric about crossing the line between good and ‘not so good’…. We’re very proud of this track and can’t wait to perform it live!” 
 
The accompanying performance video, directed by Patric Ullaeus, captures Europe firing on all cylinders and showcasing the full force of their live presence. It puts their chemistry, musicianship and sheer energy front and centre, allowing the intensity of ‘Scandinavian Eyes’ to speak for itself.

Watch and listen to Europe’s recently released and celebrated singles ‘The Cult of Ignorance’ and ‘One on One’, here: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLN8lRqp7bUzBhbCW1Xhjg7--tYMFzW3U0&si=BCv_4TGxWUVYIE34 Videos directed by Patric Ullaeus.

Come This Madness was recorded at RMV Studio, the Stockholm-based recording facility founded by Benny Andersson and Ludvig Andersson. The album features special guests Tobias Forge (Ghost) and Mikael Åkerfeldt (Opeth) on backing vocals and was produced by acclaimed producer Tom Dalgety (Ghost, Rammstein, Pixies, The Cult, Opeth), who became a true creative force throughout the process, deeply embedded in the band’s writing and recording, shaping the album’s sound from the ground up. To bring the project to its final stage and complete their vision, the band turned to one of rock’s most respected recording legends Mike Fraser (AC/DC, Van Halen, Metallica, The Cult, Loverboy) to mix the record.

With Come This Madness, Europe deliver a landmark record that finds them fully realised and present, confronting the realities of the modern world with conviction and creativity. Building on the momentum surrounding the album's release, the band will also embark on an extensive tour to celebrate the 40th anniversary of The Final Countdown. Kicking off in Glasgow on September 30th, The Final Countdown 40th Anniversary Tour promises to unite the legacy that defined them with the renewed energy, driving them forward today. 
Fans are urged to book quickly to avoid disappointment, as many dates are already sold out and only a very limited number of tickets remain for some other shows. For a full list of dates and ticket information, please visit: https://www.europetheband.com/

Hello DDR's (Dedicated Description Readers)!

I'm not sure what to write... there's SO MUCH going on but I really can't talk about any of it right now... Basically, the channel is pivoting a bit. We'll still do "fandom music," but we have three MAJOR projects in the works, and they're all either original IP or colabs.

Fan music is fun! We love supporting the IP's we love, but fandoms, as most of you probably know, can be challenging.
After our Insane music video got taken down a second time, we decided to reevaluate the channel a bit. We really can't afford to spend thousands of dollars and months of our time on a project if we don't know whether or not it's going to get copyright claimed and taken down before it can even recoup the cost.

Without going too in depth, we actually commissioned the Insane music video because Nate and his family were dealing with a very serious medical situation. Their medical bills were extremely high and this music video seemed like a good way to bring in a bit more income without him needing to be away from his family to create new content. They are doing much better now, which is why he gave me the OK to share this, but it was scary for a long time and they are still not completely out of the woods yet. That being said, if you have the time, he requests that you send your thoughts and prayers to him and his family.

I'm not trying to make you to feel sorry for us. We're doing fine! But I feel it's only fair to give you a bit of a heads-up that we are going to be trying some new things to try to keep the channel going. We're working VERY hard to make these projects some of the best we've ever made, and we REALLY hope you love them! Stay tuned…

Love you all!

~Gabe

🎵 L'ALBUM « FRANCE »
Un an de travail pour réaliser le plus gros projet artistique patriote français. Une chanson et un clip pour chacune des 21 anciennes régions de France : les paysages, la gastronomie, les monuments, l'histoire, les fiertés locales.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Millésime K - ÎLE-DE-FRANCE (PAROLES)

Je t'aime mon amour sous la tour Eiffel, dessinons un cœur avec nos mains dans le
ciel, un café en terrasse quand le jour se lève, dans la capitale tout devient possible
quand on rêve.

Bienvenue en Île-de-France dans la capitale, l'arc de triomphe au milieu de la place de
l'étoile, aux grands hommes la patrie reconnaissante du panthéon, faire la fête à la
foire du trône sur un air d'accordéon.

Une balade à cheval dans la forêt de Fontainebleau, après un croissant et un café dans
un petit bistrot, un footing matinal dans le bois de Vincennes, et le soir un verre entre
amis sur les berges de la Seine.

Le quartier de la défense la grande arche et les gratte-ciel, les voyageurs sont guidés
par le phare de la tour Eiffel, écouter du Édith Piaf dans les rues de Montmartre,
assister aux répliques de Molière dans les pièces de théâtre.

C’est provins ses remparts ses fêtes médiévales traditionnelles, c'est la galerie des
glaces illuminant le roi soleil, se détendre un soir d'été dans le jardin du Luxembourg,
genoux à terre Trocadéro pour lui dire « je t'aime mon amour ».

R E F R A I N
Je t'aime mon amour sous la tour Eiffel, dessinons un cœur avec nos mains dans
le ciel, un café en terrasse quand le jour se lève, dans la capitale tout devient
possible quand on rêve. 

La plus belle avenue du monde sur les Champs-Élysées, la beauté de Marie Antoinette
pouvait nous hypnotiser, danser un soir d'été dans les guinguettes de la Marne,
marcher sur le pont des arts symbole de passion et de charme.

Le parc du Vexin l'Oise et forêt de Montmorency, un Paris Brest en dessert après du
Coulommiers ou du Brie, les jardins de Versailles l'élégance à la française, et toujours
une main sur le cœur en chantant la Marseillaise.

Musée incomparable du Louvre et sa pyramide, et nos héros se reposent sous le dôme
des Invalides, les rosaces sur la cathédrale Notre-Dame de Paris, et la mémoire de nos
rois dans la basilique Saint-Denis.

Le french cancan le Moulin Rouge et ses danseuses, la forêt de Sénart et la vallée de
Chevreuse, le marché de Rungis approvisionne les professionnels, la mosaïque du
Sacré-Coeur ascenseur émotionnel.

R E F R A I N

le ciel, un café en terrasse quand le jour se lève, dans la capitale tout devient
possible quand on rêve.

Gods of Thunder the brand-new album from Saxon, will be released January 22nd and is available to pre-order from today: https://lnk.to/SaxonGodsofThunder
More pre-order listings are coming your way over the next few days so keep checking back!

#themightysaxon #saxon #godsofthunder

“‘Gods of Thunder is a mighty tale of Celtic mythology, packed with the spirit and power of true heavy metal,” exclaims Biff Byford. “Turn it up and bang your head!” 

British heavy metal legends Saxon return with Gods of Thunder, their new studio album that draws on history, fantasy, horror, ancient mythology, pagan rites and the enduring spirit of rock ‘n’ roll. Gods of Thunder is set for release via Silver Lining Music on January 22. Pre-orders available from September 2 at this location: https://lnk.to/SaxonGodsofThunder

The brand new single and title track, a powerful, anthemic journey into the world of Celtic mythology, is released today.  
“‘Gods of Thunder’ is a mighty tale of Celtic mythology, packed with the spirit and power of true heavy metal,” exclaims Biff Byford. “Turn it up and bang your head!” 

Produced by legendary founder and frontman Biff Byford and mixed by Andy Sneap (Judas Priest, Exodus, Accept and Priest guitarist), Gods of Thunder captures the band at the height of their powers, combining forceful performances with vivid, meticulously crafted storytelling. Pounding bass and drums, searing guitars and Biff Byford’s unmistakable voice combine to create a sonic barrage of pure British metal, carrying the spirit of the past, present and future. The album sees one of the world’s greatest live bands bring their legendary power and energy into the studio, delivering a metal masterpiece worthy of Saxon’s enduring legacy. Each track is built around the weight, dynamics and intricate arrangements that have long defined Saxon’s music, while the album as a whole maintains a strong sense of focus and purpose.

“We had great fun making this album,” says Biff. “This is gonna be one to beat!”

Byford’s longstanding passion for history is central to the album, with his distinctive storytelling bringing characters and events from the past vividly to life across ten powerful, quintessential Saxon songs. On “The Bloody Tower (The Ballad of Anne Boleyn)”, Byford recounts the politically charged execution of Anne Boleyn, while in “Medusa” the focus shifts to myth, driven by a taut, mesmeric riff and delivered at a relentless pace. “Remember the Alamo” charges forward with the fast-paced energy and spirit of early ’80s NWOBHM. The twin-guitar attack of Doug Scarratt and Brian Tatler is particularly prominent on “Temple of Rock”, underpinned by the rock-solid rhythm section of Nigel Glocker and Tim ‘Nibbs’ Carter. The album closes with “MI5”, a timeless headbanger that brings together themes of the Berlin Wall and Cold War espionage.

With the new single landing today, anticipation for the album is already building, while Saxon’s forthcoming UK shows are selling fast. Fans can expect a set packed with thunderous new material alongside the classic songs that have made the band a formidable live force for generations. And this is just the beginning: fans around the globe should keep their eyes peeled for further dates on the Gods of Thunder – World Tour to be announced soon.

Instagrammeine Lieben 🩵

Ich bin sooo happy, euch heute endlich mein Baby „Light Blue“ zeigen zu können! 

„Light Blue“ ist der letzte Song, den ich für dieses Album geschrieben habe und gleichzeitig auch die letzte Single, die vor dem Album-Release erscheint. Es fühlt sich deshalb gerade irgendwie ganz besonders an, diesen Song mit euch zu teilen. 🥹

Und psst… 👀 Ich habe euch im Musikvideo einen kleinen Hint zum Album-Release versteckt. Schaut also ganz genau hin vielleicht entdeckt ihr ja etwas, das ich nicht ganz zufällig ins Video eingebaut habe… 🤫

Ich hoffe von Herzen, dass euch „Light Blue“ gefällt und ihr genauso viel Liebe in dem Song spürt, wie ich es tue. 🩵

Danke, dass ihr mich auf dieser Reise begleitet. Das Album ist jetzt wirklich ganz nah. 🥹

Love you,
Eure Elif

Las pupilas se te dilatan
como una fiera cuando se desata,

como a un forastero, una persona non grata.
Estoy subiendo una escalinata,
directa al cielo, hecha de hojalata,
y ahí llegas tú, acción inmediata,
con fuego en los ojos y un martillo de plata.

no soy lo que quieres ver,
no ves que estoy levitando

al que me quisiste anclar.

creyendo que yo lo hice mal…
en la autopsia de mi vida
solo fuiste otra mentira,
mi peor casualidad.

Lo que no es mentira 
es que entre tú y yo hay algo 
que no sé a qué se debe,
juntos somos la prueba
de que el amor a todo le puede…
